tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim gyi man ngag go don dang bcas pa mdo tsam gyi yi ge bde chen rol pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim gyi man ngag go don dang bcas pa mdo tsam gyi yi ge bde chen rol pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim gyi man ngag go don

dang bcas pa mdo tsam gyi yi ge bde chen rol pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ swa sti swa sti bha bāntu/ na mo badzra yo gi nī nāṃ/ 'bum phrag 'char ka'i 'od 'chang 'khril ldem sku/ /rab chags bde bas myos pa'i 'jo sgeg can/ /mi phyed sngags kyi de nyid rtag 'char ba/ /rdo rje btsun mos bdag la thugs brtser mdzod/ /zhabs sen snar ma'i mdza' bo'i 'od ris dag /srid gsum bde byed sa 'dzin rtser bkod las/ /yon tan ge sar rdul gyis yongs brdal bas/ / phyogs kun ku mud nags tshal skal bzang gyur/ /gang gi bka' drin kun dga'i dga' ston la/ /brtse dgar rol las bde chen mdza' mo yis/ /rnam kun rtse 'jos yid dga' thob 'di mtshar/ /de phyir 'di ni bla ma dam pa'i lung*/ /gang dag phyogs su lhung ba'i blo/ /legs pa'i tshul la dpyod med de/ / rta gdong bdag po'i 'od gsal ba/ /sbyin skyes rnams la mun pa nyid/ /smra mang yi ge gdams pas dman/ /rnyed pa'i lcags kyu ya mtshan rmad/ /gzhan du mi dbang tshig gcig gis/ /grong khyer yul 'khor bcas mnga' bdag /de lta bas na bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang chen po rnams kyi zhal lung ste/ de yang rgyud thams cad kyi mthar thug pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i snying po'i nges gsang mchog las brtsams te/ tshe gcig kho nas rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du byed pa ste/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma kho na la brten nas rim pa gnyis bsgom par bya ba las/ dang po bskyed pa'i rim pa ni 'dir bshad par bya la/ phyi ma rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni re zhig gzhan du shes so/ /de yang dpal rdo rje 'chang he ru ka yab yum gyi dkyil 'khor rab 'byams las grub chen nā ro pas dngos su brnyed pa ste/ de la 'dir sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi'i nyams len gnyis las/ dang po la/ skyabs sems rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams spyi dang mthun pa nyid do/ /de la yang thog mar re re la rtags thon thon sbyong zhing*/

de dag tu cung zad spros pa la dga' ba'i rigs yin na/ phyag dang bskor pa sā tsa gdab pa sogs bsags sbyang spros pa mang du bya la/ bsdus pa la dga' ba'i rigs ni bla ma'i mos gus kyis bskul ba'i dmigs pa so so nyid 'bad de bya ba kho nas don tshang ba yin no/ /phyis ni thun gyi thog mar ci rigs bsgoms pas 'grub bo/ /de dag kyang re re kho na dang*/ gnyis ldan dang*/ gsum ldan dang*/ bzhi ldan sogs rang rang gi blo dang 'tsham par ci rigs rigs su bsgom pa ste/ 'khrid kyi sngon 'gro'o/ /de nas dngos gzhi'i nyams len la rnal 'byor bcu gcig yod pa/ bsdu na thun gyi sngon 'gro rnal 'byor dngos gzhi/ rjes thun mtshams te gsum las/ dang po la/ spros pa la mos na/ bar chad zhi ba'i phyir sngon 'gro gtor ma/ rten byin rlabs/ rang lhar bsgoms pas bdag bsrung/ go cha dgod pas rnal 'byor bsrung ba/ tshams rngam gyis gnas bsrung ba/ zhing sbyong zhing lha mnyes pa'i phyir gnas dang yo byad byin rlabs rnams kyang*/ gzhung bzhin thun thams cad dam thog ma lta bu gcig la bya/ mi spro na de dag bsnyen pa sogs rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i skabs mi dgos shing*/ bsgrub mchod sogs la ni nges par bya ba yin no/ /'dir nges par sbyar ba ni ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las 'bras mi bslu ba/ cis kyang dgos med rnams blo 'gyur ba thon nges re bya/ de nas skyabs 'gro spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ de rjes dam rdzas byin gyis brlabs nas/ bdud rtsi myang bas snying ga'i baṃ yig la mchod par mos shing*/ rang gi lus 'od ltar dwangs pa dang bde bas tshims par bsam/ 'bru gsum dag tu brjod/ 'di ni sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa kun rdzob byang sems kunda bde chen gyi sems bskyed pa'o/ /de rjes su tshad med kyi rnal 'byor ni/ tshad med bzhi yang byang chub kyi sems su 'dus pa yin pas/

mdo sngags thun mong gi sems bskyed pa gsal 'debs pa nyid yin la/ de'i yan lag tu tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgoms kyang rung ngo*/ / spro na yig brgya'i rnal 'byor spyi dang mthun pa zhig bar 'dir byed pa'i srol yod pa ltar byar rung la/ nges par dgos pa'i cho ga ni ma yin no/ /de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor skabs/ rdo rje chos ni gsung rdo rje yin la/ bla ma'i sku drin yang gtso bor gsung gi sgo nas thob pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bla ma rdo rje chos su sgom pa man ngag yin cing*/ sku mdog dmar pos sems can la snying rje chen pos rjes su chags pa mtshon/ ḍa ma ru'i sgras grag stong bde stong nyid spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ thod pas mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po/ kha ṭwāṃ 'dir yum mtshon cing*/ de'i don la bde stong dbyer med thabs shes ngo bo gcig pa'i zung 'jug tu mtshon pa/ thugs bde stong gi snang cha rdo rje chos kyi rnam par shar ba ni/ sku dang ye shes zung 'jug ste de mtshon byed do/ /de'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung chos/ thugs sangs rgyas te/ de yang mthar thug gi skyabs gsum ngo bo gcig pa'i gnad kyis yin no/ /de ltar yang*/ thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir/ /tshogs kyang de'i mthar thug phyir/ /zhes so/ /de la gsol ba btab pas rang la thim pa yan chad bla ma'i rnal 'byor te/ de ltar na/ skyabs 'gro/ tshad med/ rdor sems kyi rnal 'byor rnams spyi dang thun mong yin la/ bdud rtsi myang ba dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni thun mong ma yin pa ste/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro'o/ /dngos gzhi la/ bskyed rim dang bzlas pa gnyis las/ dang po la gsum ste/ mngon rtogs dngos gzhi ji ltar bsgom pa'i rim pa dang*/ 'di kho nar bskyed rim gyi yan lag rnams dang lam thams cad tshang bar rtsi ba dang*/ dmigs pa'i gtso bo lha'i snang zhen la bslab pa'o/ /dang po la/ gang 'tshang rgya ba'i rang bzhin/

gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i zhing*/ ji ltar 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul/ sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa bsgom pa ste bzhi las/ dang po ni 'chi ba chos sku lam du 'khyer ba yin te/ de yang bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi rkyen nges sad pa las/ rnam par mi rtog pa cung zad gcig sgom par bya la/ de ni gong du tshad med kyi snying rje chen po dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi mos gus byin rlabs dang*/ bdud rtsi myang ba'i bde ba rnams/ skabs 'dir mi rtog pa'i stong nyid dang ro gcig tu bsres pa la mnyam par 'jog pa'i don te/ rang bzhin bde stong zung 'jug snying rje dang byin rlabs kyi thabs las mngon du gyur pa mthar thug pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes zhes bsnyad pa yin cing*/ 'dis 'chi srid sbyong zhing*/ 'bras bu chos sku mngon du byed pa'i sa bon gsos 'debs pa dang*/ lam gong ma rdzogs rim bsgoms pa na/ don gyi 'od gsal rgyud la skye ba'i gzhi 'dings pa yin no/ /'di kho nar ma zad/ bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa'i gtso bo thams cad la/ dag rdzogs smin gsum tshang ba zhig dgos te/ mar 'khor ba dang rnam pa mthun pas srid pa sbyong zhing dag par byed pa dang*/ yar sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs tshul dang mthun pas 'bras bu rdzogs byed dang*/ bar du rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gro ba gcig rnams tshang dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ snying gar chos 'byung gsal gdab pa'i skabs yin te/ gzhi dus kyi sems can rnams gang du skye ba'i snod kyi 'jig rten 'grub pa'i bag chags sbyong*/ 'bras bu'i dus gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i zhing rnam par dag pa'i thabs te/ chos 'byung 'og ma spyir snod kyi 'jig rten dang*/ gong mas mngal skyes kyi mngal dang*/ sgong skyes kyi sgo nga'i khyim dang*/ skye gnas gzhan gnyis kyi gnas kyi bag chags sbyong bar byed do/ /chos 'byung 'og ma ni stong pa nyid/ gong ma ni stong pa de'i rang gdangs snying rje/

phyi dkar la nang dmar ba bde ba chen po/ bsnol mar gnas pa ni bde ba stong pa snying rje gsum ming dang ldog pa'i chas phye ba ma gtogs/ ngo bo sems dang ye shes su gcig pu gnyis med par mtshon te/ chos 'byung de gnyis ka'ang gdengs ka zur gsum gyen bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra zur gcig pa thur du bstan pa ste/ spyir zur bzhi pa yin la/ phyogs gang nas bltas kyang zur gsum mo/ /de yang gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma las/ longs spyod bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /rig ma'i skyes bu rdo rje can/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /gru gsum du ni rnam par sgom/ /zhes pas/ zur gsum 'og mas rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa gsum dang*/ gong mas sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang*/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje gsum mtshon no/ /zur gsum mtshan pa gnyis kyang sku gsung thugs gsum dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum mtshon te/ de la zur 'og mas ni gsum ka la khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo 'dus ma byas dang*/ bde chen kyi snying rje dang*/ gzhi dus kyi 'gyur bde lam dus dang*/ 'bras dus kyi ye shes rdo rje tshon pa ste/ longs spyod bzhi sogs kyi don no/ /stong pa nyid shes rab kyi ngo bo yin pa dang*/ gru gsum gyi rnam pas bde chen 'dren byed gsang ba'i bha ga mtshon pas rig ma'i skyes bu zhes chos 'byung la btags pa'o/ /de la rnam par thar pa gsum ni/ ji skad du/ ngo bo nyid dang bral phyir stong pa ste/ /rang bzhin rgyu dang bral bas mtshan ma med/ /rtog pa kun dang bral phyir dngos rnams kun/ /ma lus smon pa las ni nges par grol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ 'di la bshad lugs mang na'ang*/ 'dir dngos po gang la yang ngo bor rang bzhin mi dmigs pa ni stong nyid dang*/ rgyu rkyen gyi 'char sgo ma 'gags bzhin du rgyu rkyen rang bzhin ma dmigs pa'i skye med ni mtshan ma med pa dang*/

'bras bu rang bzhin mi dmigs pas de la rnam rtog med pa ni smon med de/ snying rje gsum la yang ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba bshad khungs dang ldan pa mang mod kyi/ 'dir na re zhig spyi skad dang mthun par bya ste/ sems can rnams sdug bsngal ba las sgrol 'dod pa ni sems can la dmigs pa/ sems can rnams phra ba'i mi rtag pa skad cig gis skye 'jig can las skyob par sems dpa' ni chos la dmigs pa/ sems can ma dmigs bzhin du de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la brtse ba mi rtog pa'i rang bzhin du shar ba ni dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje ste/ phyi ma 'di dngos ni so so skye bo la med mod/ phyogs mthun ni phung sogs 'khrul ba'i snang ba 'di ye nas/ grub rgyu med pa brjod bral du 'dug pa la/ der ma rtogs pa la snying rjer shar ba'i gdangs ma 'gags shing*/ de la bden 'dzin mngon gyur gyi bdag pos ma bcos pa zhig 'byung ba'o/ /de ltar na grub pa'i don stong pa'i sems las skye srid len pa'i sems sogs 'byung zhing skye ba len pa sogs 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ ji skad du/ btsun mo'i bha ga bde chen du/ /ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cur ldan/ /zhes pa ltar/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i lha bskyed pa sogs thams cad stong pa'i rang bzhin gyi gdangs de kho na las 'byung ba zhig dgos te/ stong pa las lha sku 'byung ba mtshon no/ /gzhan yang chos 'byung ni thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i zhing khams rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mtshon pa yin cing*/ chos 'byung 'og ma bde skyong 'khor lo dang*/ steng ma sprul pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ zla ba chos 'khor dang*/ baṃ yig longs spyod 'khor lo dang*/ yi ge so gnyis bde chen 'khor lo mtshon pas/ rdzogs rim skabs rtsa 'khor de rnams grol zhing dag pa dang*/ 'od zer spro bsdu dang 'od kyi gong bus 'bar 'dzag dang*/

dga' 'khyil bzhi ni thig le bzhi dang 'byung bzhi'i rlung*/ lag bcu drug ni thig le 'pho ba bcu drug ste/ de rnams byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdzogs rim gyi skabs mi 'gyur ba'i thig le thob pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ chos 'byung der zla ba sgom pa nas go cha ma bkod par te/ de la zla ba ni pha'i khu ba/ baṃ yig ni bar do'i sems nyid/ sngags 'phreng ma'i rdul/ de gsum 'dzom pa yin ni/ ji skad du/ de rjes khu khrag zhu thig le/ / 'dres pa ru ni gyur pa na/ /kun gzhi las ni rnam shes skye/ /ji ltar chang ros myos pa bzhin/ /zhes so/ /de la zla ba la baṃ yig bkod pa'i rjes su yi ge so gnyis gsal btab na/ pha'i khams dkar po bar do zhugs zin pa de mngal du 'jug pa mtshon cing*/ zla ba sngags 'phreng sngon la bskyed nas/ baṃ yig phyis bsgoms na/ mngal du dkar dmar tshogs zin pa la bar srid 'jug pa spyod pa dang*/ dus mnyam du bskyed pa ltar na/ gsum tshogs pa tsam la bar do'i lus ma 'gag pa'i skabs dang sbyor ro/ /de nas de gsum 'dres pa dang*/ 'od 'phros pa na rlung bcu sogs rim pas grub pa/ sdig sgrib sbyangs pa ni yan lag rdzogs par 'grub pa'i 'gal rkyen spangs pa yin la/ 'di nyid kyi lugs srol 'ga' zhig las/ 'od zer phyi rol tu yang spro bsdu byed pa'i man ngag yod pa'ang mi legs pa ma yin no/ /tshur 'dus thim pa ni/ phung khams skye mched rim pas grub pa/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa ni dbang po rnams rdzogs nas btsas pa/ de yang zla ba sngags 'phreng baṃ yig dus gcig la bskyed nas rim pas gsal gdab pa 'di bar do longs spyod rdzogs sku lam 'khyer te/ de yang gzhi dus 'chi ba 'od gsal las ldang ba dang bar do 'grub pa dus mnyam/ bar do 'gag pa dang skye srid 'grub pa dus mnyam pa yin pa de sbyong zhing*/ rdzogs rim skabs 'od gsal dag pa'i lhar ldang ba'i smin byed du 'gro la/

'bras dus chos sku las longs skur bzhengs pa'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ro/ /zla ba sa bon sngags 'phreng bcas gcig tu 'dres pa phan chad skye ba sprul sku lam 'khyer yin no/ /bskyed zin nas kyang chos 'byung zla ba baṃ yig sngags rnams sngar ltar bsgom dgos shing*/ sngags rnams ni mgo gyen bstan baṃ yig la kha mngon du phyogs pa'o/ /de yang thig le zla ba khu ba sku/ /rnam par bcad pa rdul nyi gsung*/ /a yig mun can thugs rab brjod/ /zhes pa ltar/ 'dir yang ma'i rakta gsung gi chos yin pas sngags su bkod pa dang*/ baṃ gyi srog la yang a yig gi don tshang ngo*/ /skye gnas gzhan gyi tshul la'ang*/ zla ba sngags 'phreng dang 'od kyi gong bu sgong skyes kyi khu bcud dang sems 'dres pa sbyong zhes bla ma dag gsung la/ don ni gzhan rnams mnga' skyes dang 'dra ba las/ 'od kyi gong bus sgong las skyes pa'i bag chags sbyong ba yin la/ zla ba dang sngags 'phreng ni drod gsher skyes la gsher dang drod gnyis dang*/ rdzus skyes la/ gnas lus la sred pa dang len pa'i mthu gsos btab pa mtshon cing sbyong ba yin no/ /rdzogs rim skabs kyang khams dkar dmar 'du 'phrod las bde chen gyi lha bskyed pa dang*/ 'bras bu longs skus sprul pa rags pa'i sku 'dzin pa'i tshul ston pa dang 'dra'o/ /skabs 'dir sku'i rnam pa'i mtshon don rnams kyang shes dgos te/ 'og tu 'chad pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ go cha 'ching ba/ ye shes pa dgug gzhuga'agro ba dag pa rnams te/ de la go cha bcings pas phung khams byin gyis brlab cing*/ go cha'i haṃ yoṃ ni/ snying kha'i baṃ yig gi gong tsam du bsgom pa yin la/ phaṭa ni tshigs chen la bskong ba'i 'od kyis lus kyi phyi thams cad dgang bar bsgom mo/ /'di rnams bsgoms pas bgegs dang bar chad kyis mi tshugs shing*/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs 'khor lo lnga dang*/ tshigs kyi 'khor lo kun gyi rlung dang thig le la dbang thob pas dbu mar thim par byed pa'i rten 'brel du 'gyur la/

'tshang rgya ba'i tshe rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor mngon du 'gyur ba'i rgyu'o/ /ye shes pa bstim pa'i gnas skabs su/ dam ye mchog dman tha dad du 'dzin pa spong zhing*/ ye shes pa der rang sems su shes shing*/ rdzogs rim skabs dpe'i 'od gsal gyi thabs kyis don gyi ye shes mtshon pa'i rgyu dang*/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas pa'i tshe thams cad ye shes gcig tu 'gyur pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o/ /'gro ba dag pa ni/ snying ga'i 'od kyis phog pas phyi nang gi 'jig rten thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom pa ste/ zhing sbyong ba dang 'gro ba smin pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /de ltar gsum la/ gzhi dus su yang go cha bkod pas skye mched dang sgo gsum gyi nus pa mthar gyis yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ dam ye bsres pas 'gro ba ris mthun snga ma rnams dang sems dang dran pa dang blo gros kyi nus pa mnyam pa dang*/ lo bcu gnyis sam bcu drug gi mthar bde ba rdzogs pa mtshon te/ yo ga shuddho'-i sngags kyis nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i skabs 'khyud rgya byed pa'i gnad kyang de yin no/ /'gro ba dag pas ni/ rang rang gi las kyi bya ba la gnas pa dang mtshungs so/ kha cig rigs bdag rang chas dang*/ kha cig rigs bdag gi dod du rdo rje phyed pa byed do/ /'on kyang 'dir dbang bskur rgyas btab sgos su mi byed pa'i lugs la thod skam lnga rigs lnga mtshon byed kyi dbu rgyan rang chas so/ /gnyis pa 'di de kho nar bskyed rim gyi yan lag rnams dang*/ lam thams cad tshad rtsi ba ni/ lhar bsgom pa bum dbang gi lam/ chos 'byung sogs ni gsang dbang gi lam/ g.yon bskor du 'khor ba'i bde ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi lam/ de la mi rtog pa bde stong dbyer med dbang bzhi pa'i lam/ chos 'byung rang nyid gsang dbang*/ dga' ba 'khyil ba shes rab ye shes/ mi rtog pa dbang bzhi pa'o/ /yang chos 'byung 'og mas gsang gnas/

gong mas lte ba sprul 'khor mtshon te/ de gnyis na rtsa mdud gru gsum gnas pas so/ /zla ba ni mi shigs pa'i thig le mtshon pas/ snying kha chos 'khor dang*/ baṃ gyis mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud mtshon pa dang*/ yi ge so gnyis ni spyi bo'i rtsa so gnyis dang byang sems so gnyis 'bab pa mtshon pas gsang dbang dang*/ 'khor lo de dag tu dga' ba bzhi 'char ba ni dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhis mtshon te shes dbang dang*/ dga' 'khyil re re la lag bzhi bzhi bcu drug ni mas brtan dga' ba bcu drug dbang bzhi pa ste/ dbang bzhi stan thog gcig tu dril pa'o/ /zhes bla ma gong ma rnams gsung ngo*/ /gzhan yang zla ba me long ye shes dang*/ /nyi ma'i dod sngags 'phreng mnyam nyid dang*/ baṃ yig sa bon sor rtog ste sbyor ba dang*/ rnal 'byor dang po yin la/ 'od 'phro 'du bya grub dang*/ sku yongs rdzogs chos dbyings ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /de rnams bsnyen pa'i yan lag yin cing*/ go cha ni nyer bsgrub ste shin tu rnal 'byor dang*/ ye shes pa bstim pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang*/ zhing sbyong sogs bsgrubs pa chen po dang*/ go cha sogs gsum po de las rgyal mchog dang*/ phyi ma gnyis rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /bde mchog gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sku gsum lam phyed kyang tshang ste/ lhar bzhengs pa yan chad sprul sku lam byed dang*/ go cha nas bzlas pa'i bar longs sku lam byed dang*/ bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor chos sku lam yin cing*/ gzhan yang don gyis na mkhyen gsum lam byed kyang tshang bar mngon la/ rgyud sde spyi la grags pa'i sku gsum lam byed ni gong du bshad zin to/ /'di dag lung dang sbyar rgyu mang mod kyi yi ge nyung ba la mngon par dga' ba'i phyir ma spros so/ /gnyis pa lha'i snang zhen la bslab pa la gsum/ gsal snang la bslab pa dang*/ nga rgyal bslab pa dang*/ bde stong du 'char ba la bslab pa'o/ /dang po la yang rnam pa la bslab pa dang*/

dag pa la bslab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo'i steng gi nor bu la sems 'dzin te/ de yang mi rus kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar gdan zlum po la gnas pa'i tog zlum po'i rnam pa la sems 'dzin/ sems 'dzin tshul spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de nas 'khor lo las gyes pa'i rus pa'i drwa ba dang*/ dbu rgyan rin po che'i rtse phran cung zad dang bcas pa'i thod skam lnga po la sems 'dzin/ de nas thod skam lnga'i sbrel thag rdo rje nag po'i 'phreng ba steng 'og tu rim pa gnyis dang*/ snyan ltag tu dpa' mo'i dar dpyangs ljang khu gsum 'khyog tu lding ba dang*/ bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra grol ba sil le bun ne bas sku stong khyab pa nā ga ge sar gyi me tog sil mas brgyan pa dang*/ spyan dbus ma dang*/ spyan gnyis te mtha' dmar zhing spyan 'bras nag pa/ rnam par bkra la g.yo zhing hur bag tu gzigs pa'i spyan gsum dang*/ shangs dkyus zul zul cung zad mtho zhing mdzes pa dang*/ smin phrag tu khro gnyer 'khyog po bsdus pa dang*/ snyan shal ring la mdzes pa dang*/ rus pa'i snyan cha dang*/ mgrin pa sgeg bag chags pa dung 'khyil ba'i ri mo lta ba dang*/ mgul rgyan dra phyed dang*/ skra mtshams su rus pa'i za ra tshogs dang*/ de nas 'jam la ring zhing phra sbom phyed la shugs dang ldan pa'i phyag g.yon steng phyogs su thod pa 'dzin tshul dang*/ de la zhal ras gyen du phyogs pa ni/ bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor rab tu gang ba yid tsam 'dzum zhing*/ khro chags 'dres pa'i nyams can mche ba'i myu gu lhag ger gsal ba dang*/ phyag g.yas thur du drag tu brkyangs shing sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i bsnun thabs dang*/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug g.yas pas 'dzin pa dang*/ yang na 'dir rdo rje dang ḍā ma ru lhan cig tu bzung bar byas kyang rung la/ sgrub thabs khungs ma gzhan las rdo rje kho na yang bshad cing 'dir ḍā ma ru g.yas su bzung na kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru bcangs pa mi byed cing*/

'dir ḍā ma ru med na kha ṭwāṃ ga la cang te'u btags pa dgos so zhes kyang lugs gzhan no/ /de bzhin du rab dkar thod pa dmar la dwangs pa'i rakta'i rgyun gyis gang ba cung zad yo bar bzung bas/ khrag gi rgyun zhal tu gsol ba dang*/ de nas dpung gdub gnyis dang*/ phyag gdub gnyis dang*/ mtho la zlum zhing mkhregs pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa dang*/ mnyen lcug 'khril bag chags pa'i sked skabs dang*/ thod dum gyi 'og pag can gyi ske rags las dra ba dra phyed dril bu gsil gsil 'phyang ba dang*/ lhag par rgyas pa'i sta zur dang*/ lte ba'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i lto ba dang*/ ze'u lhag ger bzhad pa'i bha ga mtho la sdug pa dang*/ mkhrang bag chags pa'i brla dang bcas pa'-i zhabs g.yon bskum pa dang*/ g.yas brkyang ba dang*/ zhabs gdub las g.yer kha 'khrol ba dang*/ de nas 'jigs byed kha bub tu bsgyel ba'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltab nas rna ba g.yon pa steng du lta ba mnan pa dang*/ dus mtshan ma thal mo spyi bor sbyar ba gan kyal du bsgyail ba'i nu ma nas/ skye gnas kyi bar mnan pa dang*/ manda ra ba gsar du kha bye ba lta bu'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'brum phrag 'phro ba dang sna tshogs padma 'dab ma mang po can lhag par rgyas pa'i gdan dang*/ me dpung drag tu 'bar ba'i dbus na/ sku lus li khri'i mdangs can dmar la dwangs shing 'od 'phreng 'khrug pa padma ra ga'i lhun po la thun mtshams kyi dmar bas phog pa lta bu'i sku mdog dang*/ phrag pa g.yon la brten pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga yab dpal he ru ka'i ngo bo/ de yang rtsa ba na rdo rje rtse gcig /de'i steng du keng rus kyi dbyug pa'i rtse mo la bum pa sna tshogs rdo rjes kha brgyan pa las ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha dang*/ ba dan lce gsum pa dpyangs pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du mi mgo rlon pa sngo nag/rid pa dmar po/ brlan bral gyi thod ril dkar po rnams brtsegs pa/

rtse mo rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang bcas pa la rim pas sam/ cig car sems 'dzin pa ste/ de yang kha ṭwāṃ ga phrag par 'phred la bkal ba dang*/ mchan khung du brten pa dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ ga'i 'og gi rtse mo thod pa dang lhan cig phyag g.yon pas bzung bar 'dod pa ste lugs gsum mo/ /de ltar cha sum cu so bdun du rim pas slob pa ni man ngag gi rjes su 'brangs pa'o/ /mthar cig car gsal gdab ste/ gsal dwangs snyog pa med pa nam mkhar 'ja' tshon shar ba lta bu la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag /gang la dmigs pa 'dzin pa'i yul gyi khyad par ma gtogs/ 'dzin lugs ni thun mong yin no/ /go rim 'di kho na dgos pa rang yang ma yin pas/ gang sems bzung glod nas bzung nas chog ste/ bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa 'di lta bu dag la/ rgya bod kyi bla ma rnams rim pa mi 'dra ba dang*/ thun grangs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs mdzad mod/ 'ga' zhig rim gyis bslab mi dgos pa yang yod pas ci rigs su bslab bo/ /gnyis pa ni/ dag pa dran pa sangs rgyas chos/ zhes pa ltar/ dag pa 'di rnams mngon rtogs nam bsgom pa'i tshe dran par yang bya dgos la/ 'dir de la/ der mos pa shugs drag pos sbyong ba yin te/ dag pa de la bzhi ste/ phyi dang*/ nang dang*/ gsang ba dang*/ de kho na nyid dag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ chos thams cad la chos dbyings stong pa gnyis med pas zhal gcig ma/ de'i ngang las gdod ma nas ma g.yos kyang*/ cha tsam gyis dbye na/ gdod ma'i bden pa gnyis yod pa'i kun rdzob phyag g.yon/ don dam phyag g.yas te/ de gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug ni sku gcig pu/ zhabs g.yon thabs snying rjes 'jigs byed myang 'das kyi mtha' dang*/ g.yas shes rab stong pas dus mtshan 'khor ba'i mtha' gnon pa ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las kyang*/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*/ /snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa/ /zhes pas/ mi gnas tshul 'di mdo dang thun mong ngo*/ /yang 'jigs dus gnyis chad par lta ba dang*/

rtag par lta ba mtshon pas thabs shes gnyis kyis de gnyis sel ba'ang yin no/ /zhal steng du phyogs pa yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang*/ thod skam lnga ni/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga/ mgo 'phreng lnga bcu sems las byung ba lnga bcu dag pa spyan gsum ni dus gsum mkhyen pa/ mgul rgyan sbyin pa/ gdu bu tshul khrims/ rna cha bzod pa/ spyi bo'i nor bu brtson 'grus/ ska rags bsam gtan/ gang la rgyan pa'i sku shes rab/ gcer mo ni kun rtog spangs pa/ gri gug rang gzhan gyi 'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal ma rig pa lta ba ngan pa/ the tshom ste rtsa nyon drug gcod pa/ thod pa ni rnam rtog gi mgo thod gcod pa ste/ rtog med kyi ye shes yin la/ nang bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba ni/ ye shes des bdud bzhi bcom pa/ skra grol ba ni sgrib gnyis dag pa/ kha ṭwāṃ ga zhes pa ni bod skad du bsgyur na/ mkha' dbyug ste/ chos sku nam mkha' lta bu las ma g.yos bzhin du gzugs skur ston pa*/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba ni bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis srid pa gsum bsregs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ye shes rtog med las nam yang ma g.yos bzhin du/ de nyid kyi 'char sgo dag pa'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams su snang ba sku dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa ni zhal gcig ma/ /mgo 'phreng ni yi ge lnga bcu phyag gnyis ni rkyang ma dang ro ma/ phyag mtshan gnyis ni khu ba dang rakta kha ṭwāṃ ga dbu ma/ zhabs gnyis ni gzung 'dzin du snang ba'i sems rlung ldang 'jug dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin/ 'jigs dus gnyis der bkag cing gnon pa/ zhal gyen du phyogs pa ni gtum mo gyen du 'bar ba/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun zhal du 'bab pa/ haṃ las byang sems 'dzag pa/ skra gol ba ni bde ba rgyas pa/ gcer mo ni bde bas rnam rtog gcod pa/ phyag rgya lnga ni phung po lnga bde ba thob pas rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gtso mo'i sku ni shes rab yum kha ṭwāṃ ga'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang*/

bha ga mnyam par sbyor ba/ rtsa dung can dang mkha' 'gro gdong mtshon cing*/ zhabs gnyis kyis 'jigs byed yab yum mnan pa ni/ de ltar snyoms 'jug gi rkyen gyis g.yas g.yon gyi rgyu ba dung can mar 'gags pa/ phyag gnyis ni de'i rkyen gyis steng gi lam gnyis dbu mar thim pa/ bde ba'i ye shes kyis nyon mongs gcod pa dang*/ dngos grub thams cad stsol pa ni spyan gnyis te/ gzhan rnams nang bshad dang 'dra'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ lam dus kyi skabs rnams sngar bshad pa de rnams su tshang mod/ 'dir 'bras dus la sbyor ba gtso che ba yin no/ /chos dbyings kun tu 'gro ba rang bzhin bde ba chen po ni bde chen gyi sku ste zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum ni sku gsum/ phyag gnyis ni tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa/ zhabs g.yon pa ni shes rab rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid rtsal 'ga' med du 'char bas/ zhi ba rkyang pa la mi gnas g.yas pa ni thabs bde chen gyi ye shes kyis srid pa'i nyon mongs thams cad rang bzhin med par rang mtshang rig pa'i tshul gyis rtogs pas spangs pa'i srid pa la mi gnas pa ste/ mi gnas tshul 'di ni sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /bdud rtsi gsol ba ni/ zhu bde'i rkyen gyis sems kyi rang bzhin lhan skyes mngon du gyur pa/ gri gug gi sgrib gnyis drung nas phyung ba/ kha ṭwāṃ ga a wa dhū tīr las rlung dang*/ khams dkar dmar gyi 'gros thams cad thim pa/ yang kha ṭwāṃ ga ni lha yi sku/ /shes rab ḍa ma ru yi sgra/ zhes pa ltar/ kha ṭwāṃ ga lha sku dag pa'i sgyu lus/ ka pā la zhu bde mthar thug pa'i ye shes/ cang te'u rang bzhin stong pa nyid du shes pa'o/ /de ltar na/ dang po'i grub don gzhi dus bden gnyis dbyer med kyi gnad kas/ lam thabs shes zung 'jug tu bsgoms pas/ lta ngan sel zhing yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang*/ bdud dang nyon mongs pa bcom zhing sku gnyis zung 'jug mi gnas pa'i myang 'das thob pa dang*/

gnyis pa'i don ni/ g.yas g.yon steng 'og gi rgyu ba dbu mar 'gags pas/ 'bar 'dzag bde stong gis rnam rtog gcod pa dang*/ rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor mngon du 'gyur ba dang*/ gsum pa'i don/ spyir rig ma'i kha sbyor gyi bde ba dang*/ khyad par thun mong min pa rtsa g.yas sbyor ba'i rkyen gyis thog ma 'og gi lam gnyis 'gag /de nas steng gi lam yang 'gags pas/ zhu bde khyad par can yas brtan mas brtan gyi rim pa rdzogs pa'i bde bas nyon mongs gcod cing dngos grub thams cad 'thob pa dang*/ bzhi pa'i don/ lus sgyu lus/ sems bde stong*/ lus sems ngo bor dbyer med/ rtsa 'khor rnams su rtsa rlung thig le'i bgrod pa 'gags shing thim pas/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing mi gnas pa'i myang 'das sku bzhi mngon du byed pa ste/ lha sku gcig pu 'di nyid la gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos tshang tshul te/ de dag re re la mos pa brtan po re bzhag pa'i mthar/ skyon kun spangs/ yon tan kun rdzogs sangs rgyas kun gyi yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de nyid nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal bskyed/ de tsam gyis bar chad mang po sel ba dang*/ dngos grub dang byin rlabs cher 'byung mod/ nga rgyal rnam pa lhang nge ba de la sgyu ma lta bu'i rtsis bzung nas/ ma bcos par lam du 'khyer shes na/ byang chub sgrub pa'i nye ba'i thabs su gsungs te/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges par 'grub/ / ces so/ /de yang tha mal ma dag pa'i snang ba dang*/ ma dag par zhen pa'i nga rgyal zhig yod pa la/ de dag pa'i gsal snang dang*/ dag pa'i nga rgyal du bsgyur ba yin te/ kyai rdo rje las/ rnam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog dang*/ /srid pa nyid kyis srid pa dag /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sangs rgyas ye shes zhal snga nas kyang*/ tha mal rnam rtog rgyun 'di ma gtogs pa/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal gzhan ci'ang yod ma yin/

/de dang rnam pa 'gal par gyur pa'i yid/ /des ni mngon sum dag tu rtogs par 'gyur/ /zab cing rgya che ba yi rang bzhin can/ / gang yin de ni kun rtog 'char mi byed/ /ces so/ /gsum pa bde stong du 'char ba la bslab pa ni/ skyes pa'i rten gyis ni/ ji skad du/ bud med gzugs ni spangs nas gzhan/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs su bya/ /ces pa ltar ram/ bud med kyi rten can ni thabs dang mnyam pa sbyor ba yid kyi bsgom pas zhu bde 'dren pa'am/ yang na rnal 'byor lam dang pho nya'i lam/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs la brten nas bde ba rdzogs par byas nas/ lus sems bde bar shar ba'i ngang nas lha skur gsal le ba/ nga rgyal lam me ba de la rang bzhin med par bslab par bya'o/ /'di gsum la yang rim pa 'di kho na dgos pa ma yin te/ thog mar gang nyams su blang kyang 'dra'o/ /yang man ngag las 'byung ba ltar gsang bar chos 'byung du dga' ba 'khyil ba drag tu 'khor bas bde ba bskyed par bsgom ste/ dbang gi myong ba yod na dran par byas pas bde ba dang*/ smin mtshams kyi phyi lpags pa'i nang tsam du dga' ba 'khyil ba bsgom pa'am/ smin mtshams kyi nam mkhar dga' ba 'khyil ba 'khor bas stong pa dang mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar gsungs pa ltar 'di dag kyang bsgom mo/ /'di gnyis ni yas babs dang*/ mas brtan gyi lhan skyes 'char sa gnyis la gnad du bsnun pa yin te/ gnad che ba zhig 'dug go /gnyis pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs snying gar byed pa'am/ yang na man ngag las 'byung ba 'di las dang po pa la 'phral du zab ste/ chos 'byung sa bon sngags 'phreng lte 'og gam/ gsang gnas su phab la klog pa'i tshul gyis thog mar ngag bzlas dang*/ de nas yid bzlas bya/ de yang ngag bzlas skabs gtso bor spro bsdu'i bzlas pa ci nus bya'o/ /yid bzlas la ni dang por bkod pa'i bzlas pa dang*/ de nas chos 'byung g.yon bskor du bar med du 'khor zhing*/

yi ge mi 'khor bar 'dug pa la sems gtad de/ lag len ltar bum pa can ci rigs su sgom mo/ /de la ngag bzlas ni/ 'khor bar ming tshig yi ge'i rnam rtog dang ngag gi bag chags sbyong*/ rdzogs rim rdor bzlas bum can sogs rlung gi rnal 'byor gyi sngon du 'gro bas rlung dag par byed/ 'bras bu gsung gzhom med kyi nā da'i dbyangs yongs su rdzogs pa'i rten 'brel sgrig pa'o/ /yid bzlas ni rdzogs rim gyi yan lag tu bzhed pa ltar don la'ang gnas pas/ gong gi phrugs gcig po de'i sbyang bya de dag dang mi sbyor yang*/ smin rdzogs kyi nus pa mchog dang ldan pa'o/ /bzlas bya'i sngags ni gzhung chung las snying po kho na las ma gsungs kyang*/ man ngag las rgyas pa yi ge so gnyis pa dang*/ 'bring po gzhung gi dngos bstan bzhin sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags dang*/ bsdus pa snang mdzad ma'i sngags rnams spyir gdam ngag yin pa las/ dang po gtso bor byed do/ /de yan chad dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ro/ /gsum pa rjes thun mtshams la/ bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor ni/ da lta snod bcud 'od gsal du bsdus pa/ lhar snang stong par nges pa'i phyir dang*/ khyad par khams gsum gyi dngos po rnams lus kyi cha gsum la bsdu ba ni/ rags pa thim pa/ lus dang sngags 'khor baṃ yig rnams rim pas bsdu ba/ snang ba gsum/ nā da yang bsdus pa 'od gsal te/ gzhi dus 'khor ba'i 'chi ba slar yang 'byung ba mtshon pa dang*/ lam dus su 'od gsal sgrub pa'i rgyu dang*/ 'bras dus su gzugs kyi sku mi snang bar bsdu ba mtshon no/ /slar yang thun mtshams kyi lha ldang ba ni de dang de las bar srid/ zung 'jug gi skur ldang ba mtshon cing*/ sku dang sprul pa rgyun mi 'chad pa yang mtshon no/ /yang na 'di'i tshab tu thun mtshams kyi lha la gsol ba btab pa'i rjes la/ chos 'byung sngags 'phreng zla ba baṃ yig rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur/

ro ma nas brgyud/ sna bug g.yas nas thon/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rnal 'byor mar gyur/ thams cad 'dus/ sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ rkyang ma nas brgyud nas lte bar byon/ zhabs gnyis ro rkyang gi sna la gtad pas de gnyis zhabs la thim/ dhū tīr zhugs nas gyen du gshegs/ dbu ma lus dang bcas pa je thung je thung la yal/ cung zad mi rtog par bzhag go /sna g.yon nas thon pa'i 'pho ba byed pa'ang yod mod kyi/ 'di bzang bar snang ngo*/ /'dir yang gong dang mtshungs te/ de las ldang ba ni/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pas 'gro ba rnams kyis mi mthong yang*/ don la chad pa'i mya ngan las 'da' ba mi mnga' zhing*/ 'phrin las dus rgyun chad pa med par spyod pa mtshan no/ /de ltar de thams cad 'bras bu lam du byed pa dang*/ srid pa ma spangs par lam du byed pa gzhi bsgyur pa yin pas/ dmigs pa de dang de la 'bras bu de dang de'i nga rgyal dang*/ gzhi'i chos de dang de rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin du mos pa bya dgos so/ /dmigs pa 'di 'pho ba dang 'brel ba yin gsung ngo*/ / de yang baṃ yig zla ba sngags 'phreng dang bcas pas he ru ka dpyid pa dang*/ phag mo thig le ro gcig tu bsres pa mtshon gsung*/ de la/ nang sems kyi rang bzhin baṃ yig shin tu dwangs pa'i rlung sems phra mo ste/ sbyang bya rlung sems phra mo/ /de sbyong byed ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' yin/ zla ba sngags 'phreng rlung sems gtso bor gang la rten pa'i dkar dmar 'dres pa'i thig le dpyid ces pa ste/ sbyang bya sems rags pa dang*/ lus rags pa bskyed byed khams dkar dmar/ sbyong byed ye shes sems dpa'o/ /phyi'i sku ni sbyang bya/ lus sems rten dang brten pa shin tu rags pa/ sbyong byed dam tshig sems dpa'o/ /gzhi dus kyang 'khor bar 'jug pa skye ba'i tshe de gsum snga ma snga ma la/ phyi ma phyi ma 'byung zhing*/ 'khor ba ldog

/'chi ba sogs la/ phyi ma phyi ma/ snga ma snga ma la thim 'gro bas/ skabs 'dir yang de dang rnam pa mthun par bsgoms pas/ rdzogs rim dang*/ 'bras dus 'od gsal thams cad stong pa mngon du byed pa'i rgyu dam pa'o/ /'di skabs bla ma 'ga' zhig gi gsung gong du bshad pa'i dpyid dang thig le de/ dag byed dmar cha nyi ma/ dkar cha thod skam du 'gro ba sogs mang du bzhed mod/ dpyad par bya'o/ /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ spyod lam la 'jug khar bar chad srung ba'i don du go cha dgod cing*/ mtshams bcing ba dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi lam byed dang mi 'bral ba'i phyir dag pa gsum dran pa dang*/ thun gyi dge ba spel ba'i phyir gzhan don du smon lam gdab pa rnams byas nas/ spyod lam la 'jug ste/ sku gsung thugs lam khyer dang ma bral bar byed pa'o/ /de nas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ bskyed rim ltar nyal na lha rdzas kyi gdan khri'i steng du/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan can phyag mtshan spangs pa'i tshul gyis nyal/ rdzogs rim ltar nyal na/ bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor gyi rim pas nyal nas bzhed pa ltar yin la/ 'on kyang 'di dang thun mtshams kyi lha sku la/ phyag mtshan spangs pa nges par sgom dgos pa ni ma yin cing*/ las dang po la ni rtsa ba'i dmigs pa la cung zad gnod pas/ thun gyi dmigs pa de nyid dang mtshungs par bsgoms na legs so/ /ldang ba'i rnal 'byor yang*/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis ḍā ma ru'i sgra dang snying gi sgra bsgrags pas/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal sad par mod te/ stong pa'i ngang las lha skur langs pa'am/ lha sku'i rnam pa de nyid la thugs mi rtog pa snang med de sad par mos pa byed dgos pa yin la/ de ltar na/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung las/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myang*/ /tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed/ / 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ /dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs/

/ ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang*/ /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor te/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes pa ltar las/ 'gro ba dag pa ni/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rjes la byed pa/ nā ro pa'i rgya gzhung nyid na gsal bas de ltar byas na legs shing*/ de bzhin du gzhung chung dang rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi sdom na mi gsal yang*/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ rjes chags rnal 'byor rnams/ bla med spyi 'gros kyis go nus shing*/ tshes bcu mchod pa dang*/ tshogs 'khor dang*/ gzhon nu ma mchod pa dang*/ sbyin sreg che chung dang*/ lag mchod sogs la bslab pa dang*/ lam gyi yan lag las tshogs phra mo rnams kyang man ngag bzhin shes par bya'o/ /da ni lung mdor bsdus pa dang sbyar bar bya ste/ 'di nyid grub chen nā ro ta pa'i gzhung las 'byung ba ni yin mod kyi/ rgyud gang la rten te gnas zhe na/ 'dir 'byor pa ni shin tu mang mod/ re zhig gang la brten nas mdzad pa ni/ rtsa rgyud dang kun spyod la brten te/ khyad par rdzogs rim sogs gsal bar kun spyod la brten no/ /de yang rtsa rgyud le'u dang po las/ pho nya lhan cig skyes bsgrub ni/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma ste/ /yid ni nang du chud pa yis/ /'dod pa yi ni dngos grub bya/ /'di rim pa gnyis ka'i mdor bstan yin la/ 'dir ni pho nya mo'i mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lhan cig skyes ma kho na bsgoms pas 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'grub ces pa'o/ /ji ltar bsgom na/ le'u gnyis par/ rdo rje phag mo rab 'jigs ma/ /he ru ka la mngon phyogs pa/ /spyan gsum drag po'i gzugs can ma/ ka pā la ni and+ras bkang*/ kha nas ru ti ra 'dzag shing*/ /lha dang lha min mir bcas la/ /phyogs kun tu ni sdigs mdzub byed/ /ces dang*/ so gnyis par/

de yi kha dog mtshon cha 'chang*/ /zhes phyag mtshan bstan te/ he ru ka'i rang bzhin kha ṭwāṃ ga la phyogs pa ste/ kha ṭwāṃ ga lha pho mo thams cad la yum dang yab tu mngon brjod sogs bshad rgyud rnams las gsungs pas so/ /go cha ni/ brgyad par/ oṃ haṃ hriṃ hreṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ yi ge baṃ yoṃ nyid dang ni/ /yi ge moṃ dang hriṃ nyid dang*/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa ces sbyar ba ni/ /rnal 'byor ma ni drug tu grags/ /zhes pa'o/ /dam ye bsre ba ni/ nyer brgyad par/ mchog 'bring tha ma lhan cig 'gugs/ /zhes pa dang*/ smin mtshams kyi chos 'byung dang thig le ni/ bzhi par/ a wa dhū tī'i gnas de bzhin/ /smin ma'i bar du nges par gzhug /ces so/ / gsang bar bsgom pa ni bzhi par/ khyim du dkyil 'khor mthong ba yin zhes pas bstan cing*/ nyer gsum par/ 'di yi mtshan ma khyim du ni/ /rdo rje lta bu me long bcas/ /sogs kyang phyogs mthun no/ /bskyed gzhi dang lte bar bsgoms pa'i chos 'byung sogs ni/ lnga par/ de nas chos kun 'byung ba yi/ /sna tshogs lte bar mi shigs dge /sngags pas cho ga bzhin du bri/ /chos kun gcig tu bsdus par bya/ /zhes pas bstan te/ de'i don bshad rgyud saṃ pu ṭ-i las/ /gru gsum dag pa e yi dbyibs/ /dbus su dgyes pa'i yi ge baṃ/ /gru gsum dkyil 'khor nyams dga' bar/ /rdo rje ralli rnam par 'byung*/ /btsun mo'i bha ga zhes kyang bya/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes byar bshad/ /ces dang*/ de'i 'grel pa man ngag snye ma las/ 'dis ni lte ba'i padma la sogs pa yang gsungs so/ /zhes bshad cing*/ de rnams kyis de dag ston par man ngag las 'byung bar ma zad/ lwa ba pa dang*/ nag po spyod pa'i gzhung gis kyang de ltar bshad do/ /'dis smras pa/ stong nyid mdzes mar rnam kun rol rtsed spyod/ /dga' bzhis lang tshos mang bcings chags ldan su/ /kun rtog pir gyis rnam bkra'i ri mor byas/ /de las dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba mtshar/

/'dir 'bad rnam dkar ci mchis pas/ /'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog /bdag kyang he ru ka dpal du/ /rdo rje btsun mos bsgrub par mdzod/ /bdag ni skye ba thams cad du/ /bla ma'-i bran du 'gyur ba dang*/ /zhing rnams thams cad yongs dag pas/ / 'gro ba smin par byed gyur cig /'on te dmyal bar skyes na yang*/ /de nyid las gzhan bde ba can/ /nam yang mi 'dod de bas na/ /sems kyi rdo rje mngon sum gyur/ /rdo rje slob dpon bka' yis gnang ba dang*/ /skye bo mang pos bskul nas 'di sbyar ro/ /bcu gnyis bcu drug 'khor lo yongs dag pas/ /mi 'gyur bde chen de ring thob par shog /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim gyi man ngag bde chen rol pa zhes bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i bka'i gnang ba thob pa dang*/ rtsib ri bsam gling mkhan pos bskul nas/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas phyogs mtshon tsam zhig rang lo nyer bzhi pa la/ brag stod chos kyi pho brang du brtsams pa las/ slar yang don gnyer du mas bskul ba'i ngor/ rang lo bzhi bcu pa la cung zad kha bskongs dang bcas te tshang bar bsgrigs pa yin no/ /maṅga laṃ/

rab tu dkar ba'i rten bzhengs 'dis/ /bdag cag gis ni thog med nas/ / sdig ltung gang bsags yongs dag ste/ /rlabs chen tshogs gnyis mthar phyin shog/ dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim gyi man ngag bde chen rol pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 88 -- PAGE 63 -- PAGE 62 -
